alert.name: [Critical] High error rate on checkout-api - occurrence 13 - test
alert.description:
KaiOps historical monitoring incident for contextual RCA retrieval.

ALERT DETAILS
- Alert: High error rate
- Service: checkout-api
- Source: CloudWatch
- Environment: Production
- Evidence: 5xx rate exceeded 8% for 10 minutes; occurrence 13/20. KaiOps correlation found 2 related signals across 1 monitored resources.
- Correlation ID: INC-2025-10013

ROOT CAUSE
A faulty release introduced an unhandled null response from the pricing client.

BUSINESS IMPACT
checkout-api experienced major production degradation; approximately 1069 transactions or operational events were delayed or failed. Incident response and business operations were at risk of SLA breach.

RESOLUTION STEPS
1. Rollback checkout-api to the last stable image.
2. clear affected pods.
3. verify pricing-client contract.
4. run checkout smoke tests.

VALIDATION
5xx rate below 1% for 15 minutes and checkout success rate above 99%.

PREVENTION
Add regression coverage for high error rate; retain the alert with early-warning threshold; track recurrence using scenario label kaiops-scenario-01; review capacity/configuration during the next problem-management cycle.
